name: Telecom Customer Churn
description: Telecommunications churn analysis database with customer profiles, service subscriptions, and churn prediction data. Practice predictive analytics and customer retention analysis.

tables.name: customers
tables.description: Telecom customer master data with demographics and signup dates

tables.name: services
tables.description: Available telecom services and pricing catalog

tables.name: churn_records
tables.description: Customer churn analysis with contract details, charges, and churn predictions

relationships.description: Each churn record belongs to one customer

sample_queries.title: High-Risk Churn Customers
sample_queries.description: Identify customers with high churn risk scores who haven't churned yet
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  c.customer_name,
  c.city,
  cr.contract_type,
  cr.monthly_charges_idr,
  cr.tenure_months,
  cr.churn_risk_score,
  cr.has_churned
FROM customers c
JOIN churn_records cr ON c.customer_id = cr.customer_id
WHERE cr.has_churned = false 
  AND cr.churn_risk_score >= 70
ORDER BY cr.churn_risk_score DESC;

sample_queries.title: Churn Rate by Contract Type
sample_queries.description: Calculate churn percentage across different contract types
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  contract_type,
  COUNT(*) as total_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN has_churned = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as churned_customers,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN has_churned = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 1) as churn_rate,
  AVG(monthly_charges_idr) as avg_monthly_charges,
  AVG(tenure_months) as avg_tenure
FROM churn_records
GROUP BY contract_type
ORDER BY churn_rate DESC;

sample_queries.title: Revenue at Risk Analysis
sample_queries.description: Calculate potential revenue loss from high-risk customers
sample_queries.sql:
WITH risk_segments AS (
  SELECT 
    CASE 
      WHEN churn_risk_score >= 80 THEN 'Critical'
      WHEN churn_risk_score >= 60 THEN 'High'
      WHEN churn_risk_score >= 40 THEN 'Medium'
      ELSE 'Low'
    END as risk_segment,
    cr.*
  FROM churn_records cr
  WHERE has_churned = false
)
SELECT 
  risk_segment,
  COUNT(*) as customer_count,
  SUM(monthly_charges_idr) as monthly_revenue_at_risk,
  SUM(monthly_charges_idr * 12) as annual_revenue_at_risk,
  AVG(churn_risk_score) as avg_risk_score
FROM risk_segments
GROUP BY risk_segment
ORDER BY 
  CASE risk_segment 
    WHEN 'Critical' THEN 1 
    WHEN 'High' THEN 2 
    WHEN 'Medium' THEN 3 
    ELSE 4 
  END;

sample_queries.title: Tenure Impact on Churn
sample_queries.description: Analyze relationship between customer tenure and churn behavior
sample_queries.sql:
SELECT 
  CASE 
    WHEN tenure_months <= 6 THEN '0-6 months'
    WHEN tenure_months <= 12 THEN '7-12 months'
    WHEN tenure_months <= 24 THEN '13-24 months'
    ELSE '24+ months'
  END as tenure_group,
  COUNT(*) as customers,
  AVG(monthly_charges_idr) as avg_charges,
  ROUND(AVG(CASE WHEN has_churned = true THEN 100 ELSE 0 END), 1) as churn_pct
FROM churn_records
GROUP BY tenure_group
ORDER BY 
  CASE tenure_group
    WHEN '0-6 months' THEN 1
    WHEN '7-12 months' THEN 2
    WHEN '13-24 months' THEN 3
    ELSE 4
  END;
